## Summary
- Register four 2-GPU kv_canary/mock_model e2e tests to the **`extra-a-test-2-gpu-large-amd`** suite, mirroring their CUDA `register_cuda_ci(stage="extra-a", runner_config="2-gpu-large")` gating (label-gated / opt-in, not per-commit), now that the ROCm kv_canary kernel port (#28357) and the HiCache write-back/write-check fixes have landed.
- Add a new `extra-a-test-2-gpu-large-amd` job to the shared `pr-test-amd-extra.yml` (covers both the mi325 default and the rocm720 chain via `rocm_version`), wired into `pr-test-amd-extra-finish`, and register the suite in `test/run_suite.py`.
- AMD `est_time` ≈ 1.5× CUDA: 900s for mock_model PP/TP, 330s for kv_canary PP baseline/perturb (conservative vs. measured runtime below).

## Tests added (suite `extra-a-test-2-gpu-large-amd`)

| Test file | est_time | mi325 actual | rocm720 actual |
|-----------|---------:|-------------:|---------------:|
| `mock_model/test_e2e_pp.py` | 900s | 64s | 64s |
| `mock_model/test_e2e_tp.py` | 900s | 144s | 168s |
| `kv_canary/test_self_e2e_pp_baseline.py` | 330s | 186s | 189s |
| `kv_canary/test_self_e2e_pp_perturb.py` | 330s | 351s | 267s |
| **Total** | **2460s** | **745s** | **688s** |

## Test plan
- `python3 -m py_compile` on the four edited test files (clean).
- Import-free CI collector over `test/registered/**/*.py`: `extra-a-test-2-gpu-large-amd` collects exactly the four files; `stage-b-test-2-gpu-large-amd` unchanged.
- `pr-test-amd-extra.yml` parses; new job present and in `pr-test-amd-extra-finish.needs`.
- **mi325** — `extra-a-test-2-gpu-large-amd` ✅ 4/4 passed: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/27918108641
- **rocm720** — `extra-a-test-2-gpu-large-amd-rocm720` ✅ 4/4 passed: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/27917623157

## CI Status for PR #28848

**Merge verdict:** This PR's own changes are **fully exercised and green** — the 4 newly-registered AMD 2-GPU e2e tests ran and passed 4/4 in `extra-a-test-2-gpu-large-amd` (PR Test Extra (AMD), pull_request run [27917351324](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/27917351324)). **Every executed failure is pre-existing / unrelated** to this PR (an anthropic-SDK dependency bug, a DeepSeek-V4 server OOM, and NVIDIA infra cascades). 

> [!NOTE]
> The changed code **is** covered and verified: `extra-a-test-2-gpu-large-amd` ran the 4 registered files (`kv_canary/test_self_e2e_pp_baseline.py`, `kv_canary/test_self_e2e_pp_perturb.py`, `mock_model/test_e2e_pp.py`, `mock_model/test_e2e_tp.py`) → `Test Summary: 4/4 passed` ([log L25901](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/27917351324/job/82604927999)). 

Changed files: `.github/workflows/pr-test-amd-extra.yml` (+32), `test/run_suite.py` (+8/-4), 4× `test/registered/{kv_canary,mock_model}/*.py` (+2/-1 each) — all AMD-only registration; `run_suite.py` adds only `extra-a-test-2-gpu-large-amd` to the AMD list.

**Executed CI failure attribution:** AMD: 2 failures (0 related) · Others: 2 failures (0 related; NVIDIA Base/Extra are infra/cascade)

### AMD Executed Failures

| Job | Test File | Test Function | Error | Related? | Why |
|-----|-----------|---------------|-------|----------|-----|
| [stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd (13)](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/27917351389/job/82605839538) | `test/registered/openai_server/basic/test_anthropic_server.py` | `test_in_messages_system_role` | `TypeError: HTTPTransport.__init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'socket_options'` | 🟢 Unlikely | anthropic-SDK vs httpx version mismatch in the image; PR touches no HTTP client or this test |
| [dsv4-flash-fp4-fp8-amd-rocm720](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/27917351363/job/82604938493) | `test/registered/amd/test_deepseek_v4_flash_fp4.py` | `setUpClass` | `Server process exited with code -9` (DeepSeek-V4-Flash launch crash/OOM) | 🟢 Unlikely | DeepSeek-V4 FP4 8-TP server, unrelated to kv_canary/mock_model registration |

### Other Executed Failures

| Job | Test File | Test Function | Error | Related? | Why |
|-----|-----------|---------------|-------|----------|-----|
| [extra-a-test-1-gpu-large (0)](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/27917351332/job/82604948621) + 5 cascade | N/A (log expired) | N/A | root-cause job log `BlobNotFound`; siblings `Fast-fail: skipping` | 🟢 Unlikely | NVIDIA Extra suite; PR changes are AMD-only. Collapsed: extra-b-4gpu/8gpu + extra-a 1/2-gpu are fast-fail skips of this root cause |
| [base-b-test-1-gpu-large (1)](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/27917351386/job/82605726117) | N/A | N/A | shard **cancelled** → `wait-for-base-b` gate failed | 🟢 Unlikely | NVIDIA Base infra cancellation, not a test failure |

### Details / what to do before merge
- **Nothing in this PR needs fixing for these reds.** The PR's target tests are green (4/4).
- **Anthropic AMD failure**: pre-existing dependency bug (`socket_options` kwarg) — no in-flight fix PR found via search on `anthropic`/`httpx`/`socket_options`. Affects unrelated `test_anthropic_server.py`; flag separately, do not block this PR on it.
- **Base + Extra incompleteness**: rerun the cancelled/expired jobs (or update branch) so Base-b and NVIDIA Extra produce a complete signal; if the root-cause Extra job persists after rerun, investigate it independently (its current log has expired). For a full-signal run despite unrelated early failures, the `bypass-fastfail` label is an option (uses more CI resources — use sparingly).

files.patch:
@@ -177,6 +177,37 @@ jobs:
         run: |
           bash scripts/ci/amd/amd_ci_exec.sh -w "/sglang-checkout/test" python3 run_suite.py --hw amd --suite extra-a-test-1-gpu-large-amd --timeout-per-file 1800 ${{ inputs.continue_on_error == true && '--continue-on-error' || '' }}
 
+  # =============================================== extra-a (2-gpu-large) ===============================================
+  # Two-GPU mock-model / kv_canary *e2e* tests (PP/TP), the AMD mirror of the
+  # CUDA extra-a 2-gpu-large gating. Single unpartitioned job on the 2-gpu pool
+  # for the same setup-cost reason as the 1-gpu jobs above.
+  extra-a-test-2-gpu-large-amd:
+    name: ${{ format('extra-a-test-2-gpu-large-amd{0} (linux-{1}-2gpu-sglang)', inputs.rocm_version && format('-{0}', inputs.rocm_version) || '', inputs.runner_arch || 'mi325') }}
+    needs: [call-gate]
+    if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.call-gate.result == 'success' }}
+    runs-on: ${{ format('linux-{0}-2gpu-sglang', inputs.runner_arch || 'mi325') }}
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout code
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ inputs.ref || github.sha }}
+
+      - name: Ensure VRAM is clear
+        run: bash scripts/ci/amd/ensure_vram_clear.sh rocm
+
+      - name: Start CI container
+        run: bash scripts/ci/amd/amd_ci_start_container.sh ${{ inputs.rocm_version && format('--rocm-version {0}', inputs.rocm_version) || '' }}
+        env:
+          GITHUB_WORKSPACE: ${{ github.workspace }}
+
+      - name: Install dependencies
+        run: bash scripts/ci/amd/amd_ci_install_dependency.sh
+
+      - name: Run test
+        timeout-minutes: 75
+        run: |
+          bash scripts/ci/amd/amd_ci_exec.sh -w "/sglang-checkout/test" python3 run_suite.py --hw amd --suite extra-a-test-2-gpu-large-amd --timeout-per-file 2700 ${{ inputs.continue_on_error == true && '--continue-on-error' || '' }}
+
   # =============================================== aggregator ====================================================
   # Single fan-in job so branch protection / notifications depend on one job
   # rather than every matrix leg. Fails if any dependent failed or was

         extra-a-test-1-gpu-small-amd,
         extra-a-test-1-gpu-large-amd,
+        extra-a-test-2-gpu-large-amd,
       ]
     if: always()
